description:
BM25 / keyword search over the tenant's chunks.

Use when the user mentions a specific term, name, identifier, or
quoted phrase that needs an exact (or near-exact) match. For
conceptual queries prefer ``search_knowledge``; for a blend of both
use ``search_hybrid``.

Each hit carries a ``chunk_id`` and ``materialized_path``. Pair with
``cite``/``read``/``read_around`` to ground an answer.

chunk_types.description: Only return chunks of these types.
chunk_types.title: Chunk Types

parent_path_part_ids.description: Restrict to descendants of these path-parts.
parent_path_part_ids.title: Parent Path Part Ids

query.description: Keyword or phrase to match (BM25 full-text).
query.title: Query

tag_ids.description: Only chunks whose document carries all these tags.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

top_k.description: Max number of chunks to return (1-50).
top_k.title: Top K

name: search_keyword

chunk_id.description: Stable id for this chunk. Use it with `cite`, `read_around`, `view_chunk_image`, or `read` (which now also accepts a chunk_id). NOT the same as `path_part_id`.
chunk_id.title: Chunk Id

materialized_path.description: Full root-to-leaf path of the chunk (e.g. `Folder/SubFolder/Document/Section/...`). Use this when displaying citations or grouping hits by document.
materialized_path.title: Materialized Path

path_part_id.description: PDO id of the chunk node in the path tree. Pass to `get_info` for ancestry; do NOT confuse with `chunk_id` — they are different UUIDs.
path_part_id.title: Path Part Id

score.description: Relevance score from the search backend (higher = better).
score.title: Score
